title: Enriched Holomorphic Neural Networks for 2D and 3D Laplace Problems
abstract: arXiv:2610.12541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Boundary-value problems for the Laplace equation develop singular behaviour near corners, edges and junctions that smooth approximators resolve poorly. We combine holomorphic neural networks with singular functions derived from the local geometry and boundary conditions. The representation is harmonic by construction, so no interior residual is needed: the network fits the smooth remainder from boundary data alone, and the enrichment terms capture the singular behaviour. Singular exponents are trainable, so the construction also applies when the local expansion is not known in advance. We extend the approach to three dimensions using independent networks evaluated along complex null directions. The enriched model is the most accurate tested method on every problem. Its margin is several orders of magnitude where the enrichment captures the singularity exactly, and a factor of about 1.7-2.1 over the next-best method on a CdZnTe radiation

translated_title: 面向二维与三维拉普拉斯问题的增强全纯神经网络
translated_abstract: 拉普拉斯方程的边值问题在角点、边缘和交汇处附近会产生奇异行为，而光滑逼近器对此难以很好地处理。我们将全纯神经网络与由局部几何和边界条件导出的奇异函数相结合。该表示在构造上即为调和函数，因此无需内部残差：网络仅依靠边界数据拟合光滑余项，而增强项负责捕捉奇异行为。奇异指数是可训练的，因此即使局部展开形式事先未知，该构造方法依然适用。我们利用沿复零方向求值的独立网络，将该方法扩展至三维。在所有测试问题上，增强模型都是精度最高的方法。当增强项能精确捕捉奇异性时，其优势达到数个数量级；在一个CdZnTe辐射探测器问题上，其精度比次优方法高出约1.7-2.1倍。
tldr: 本文提出将全纯神经网络与可训练的奇异增强函数相结合，利用构造性调和性免去内部残差、仅凭边界数据求解含角点奇异性的二维与三维拉普拉斯问题，精度较现有最优方法提升数个数量级至约1.7-2.1倍。
